authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states from live G04 v1 exactByteIntent and rssProtocol, and names the D-102 fleet-class labels from live G03 v4 fleetClass. v2 lands CLAUDE-G04IC-V1-SF1. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a D-006 unit. It does not authorize a binary-MB byte constant. It does not score analyze or consented-probe RSS. It does not invent a machine identifier outside D-102. It does not invent an occupancy leftover-join. G04 v3 is not this pin (CLAUDE-G04H-V3-B1). It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not close OBL-2. It does not execute G04. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Land CLAUDE-G04IC-V1-SF1. Name initial states drawn from live G04 v1 exactByteIntent and rssProtocol, with D-102 fleet-class labels drawn from live G03 v4 fleetClass (the same labels g03-input-corpus.v1 cites), with NOT-AUTHORED markers attached to those named states.

g04v1.role: Live G04 occupancy. artifactPathWhenAuthored. exactByteIntent and rssProtocol are quoted. G04 v3 is not this pin.

g03v4.role: Fleet-class source. .harness.fleetClass carries the four D-102 hosted-fleet-class labels. This catalog quotes those labels. It does not invent a machine identifier outside D-102 and does not retarget G03.
